INFANTRY_WEAPONS_1_3.name: Infantry Weapons 1-3
INFANTRY_WEAPONS_1_3.description: Improves eligible infantry attacks. Levels 2/3 need Armory and the previous level.

INFANTRY_ARMOR_1_3.name: Infantry Armor 1-3
INFANTRY_ARMOR_1_3.description: Improves infantry armor. Levels 2/3 need Armory and the previous level.

VEHICLE_WEAPONS_1_3.name: Vehicle Weapons 1-3
VEHICLE_WEAPONS_1_3.description: Improves eligible ground-vehicle weapons; sequential levels.

SHIP_WEAPONS_1_3.name: Ship Weapons 1-3
SHIP_WEAPONS_1_3.description: Improves eligible aircraft weapons; sequential levels.

VEHICLE_AND_SHIP_PLATING_1_3.name: Vehicle and Ship Plating 1-3
VEHICLE_AND_SHIP_PLATING_1_3.description: Shared armor research for mechanical vehicle/air categories; separate from infantry armor.

HI_SEC_AUTO_TRACKING.name: Hi-Sec Auto Tracking
HI_SEC_AUTO_TRACKING.description: Extends the range of affected defensive structures. Does not increase every unit's weapon range.

BUILDING_ARMOR.name: Building Armor
BUILDING_ARMOR.description: Increases structure armor; separate from unit plating.

STIMPACK.name: Stimpack
STIMPACK.description: Unlocks Stim for Marines and Marauders. The ability also spends the user's health.

COMBAT_SHIELD.name: Combat Shield
COMBAT_SHIELD.description: Increases Marine maximum health; does not increase Marauder health.

CONCUSSIVE_SHELLS.name: Concussive Shells
CONCUSSIVE_SHELLS.description: Marauder attacks slow eligible targets. It does not allow anti-air fire.

PERSONAL_CLOAKING.name: Personal Cloaking
PERSONAL_CLOAKING.description: Unlocks Ghost cloak, which still needs energy.

INFERNAL_PRE_IGNITER.name: Infernal Pre-Igniter
INFERNAL_PRE_IGNITER.description: Improves Hellion/Hellbat damage against Light targets.

DRILLING_CLAWS.name: Drilling Claws
DRILLING_CLAWS.description: Improves Widow Mine deployment behavior; Armory prerequisite. Concealment interactions are balance-version dependent.

SMART_SERVOS.name: Smart Servos
SMART_SERVOS.description: Accelerates affected transformation modes; Armory prerequisite. Does not shorten all construction or production times.

MAG_FIELD_ACCELERATOR.name: Mag-Field Accelerator
MAG_FIELD_ACCELERATOR.description: Improves the appropriate Cyclone Lock On damage interaction. Cyclone versions differ substantially;

CLOAKING_FIELD.name: Cloaking Field
CLOAKING_FIELD.description: Unlocks Banshee cloak; distinct from Ghost research.

HYPERFLIGHT_ROTORS.name: Hyperflight Rotors
HYPERFLIGHT_ROTORS.description: Improves Banshee movement speed. Does not improve its lack of anti-air capability.

INTERFERENCE_MATRIX.name: Interference Matrix
INTERFERENCE_MATRIX.description: Research entry for Raven's disable ability in the installed tables. Confirm the active baseline's research gate rather than assuming all versions share it.

WEAPON_REFIT.name: Weapon Refit
WEAPON_REFIT.description: Unlocks Battlecruiser Yamato Cannon. Battlecruiser training itself does not require this research.

MEDIVAC_ENERGY_UPGRADE.name: Medivac energy upgrade
MEDIVAC_ENERGY_UPGRADE.description: Improves Medivac energy support in the relevant balance version. Installed; display names/effects have changed across versions.
